about.headline: Main Street's chocolate and candy store since 2014.
body: In 2014, Nina Midgley, with her parents Terri & Ed Midgley, established My Favorite Sweet Shoppe on the principle of giving our local community products and customer service that are second to none.

We hand-dip our own chocolates and make our caramel in small batches, and we partner with the best vendors so every guest finds something to satisfy their sweet tooth. Our homemade lineup includes gourmet caramel apples, fresh fudge, hand-dipped chocolates and custom-designed treats.
We're proud to be the area's local chocolate and candy store, serving up a dose of nostalgia with every purchase.
